phases.name: Kana Foundations
phases.notes: Get every hiragana and katakana character into rotation first. A little vocab is mixed in so kana feels useful right away, but kanji and grammar wait until kana is underway.

phases.name: Core Building
phases.notes: Steady daily introduction of kanji, vocabulary and grammar together. A small ongoing kana allowance mops up anything not finished during Kana Foundations. Sentences unlock automatically as soon as every word they use is already known.

phases.name: Integration
phases.notes: New-card pace slows down on purpose. More emphasis shifts to full sentences and listening practice, tying together everything learned so far.

phases.name: Exam Prep
phases.notes: No new cards at all. Pure review, leech cleanup, and mixed mock-review sessions until test day.
